_about: Tables for body/MEDICINE.md. Rendered into the doc and body/data.js by build-body-data.py. kind: science | history | model | fiction. mark: rex | proposed | open. Mortality figures are untreated, modern estimates where a period figure does not exist; conf says how firm. Tables moved whole to data/library/medicine.json (no game columns): healing.

diseases.title: The disease list (period names in brackets)
diseases.source: Causes and courses are modern medicine (textbook; MED-* keys in SOURCES.md). Period presence and names from Trapham 1679, Sloane 1707, Woodall 1617, Moyle 1693, the Burnard mortality study, the Hektoen ship-fever article and the Cardiff sea-surgeons piece. Mortality figures are ranges, untreated, confidence as given per row.

wounds.source: Healing phases: hemostasis at once, inflammation 1 to 4 days, proliferation 4 to 21 days, remodelling 21 days to a year (MED-HEAL). Period handling from Woodall and Moyle. Infection and mortality ranges are the keeper's reading of the sources, medium confidence.

bleeding.title: (moved to circulation.bleeding on 2026-10-29; kept here unrendered for the record)
bleeding.source: ATLS classes of haemorrhagic shock (teaching values; the current manual gives trends). Blood volume about 70 mL/kg (standard). The class is read from the cumulative loss; the loss grows by the wound's rate x elapsed minutes (a combat turn's length is the combat keeper's), and stops when bound or when the surgeon ligates. The bleeding rates and the death risks are model placeholders, not clinical rates. MED-ATLS

hygiene.title: Hygiene as exposure: what filth does to the odds
hygiene.source: Mechanisms are modern (lice carry typhus; faecal water carries dysentery and typhoid; crowding carries smallpox, influenza, consumption). The ship side (swabbing, rats, the cleanliness meter) is PIRATE.md 5a and DUTIES.md; the place side (latrines, wells) is the town keeper's.

immunity.title: Immunity and resistance
immunity.source: Lifelong immunity after yellow fever and smallpox; partial after falciparum malaria; none after dysentery or influenza strains; Constitution as the hidden resistance stat is Rex's (STATS.md).

exposure.title: Conditions from the air (named here, caused by ATMOSPHERE, GAS_DYNAMICS and the body)
exposure.source: Standard emergency medicine for hypoxia, hypercapnia, carbon monoxide poisoning, smoke inhalation, irritant injury, hydrogen sulphide and altitude illness; the period could do nothing but carry the man into the air and bleed him. Each condition is a pattern of the body's states, never a timer (the brief's rule, kept).
